help_text:
owa-graph mail - Read, send, reply, move, flag messages

Shortcuts:
  list      List messages in a folder (default: Inbox; --unread, --top, --filter)
  read      Show a message by --id
  send      Send mail (--subject, --to, [--cc], [--body])
  reply     Reply to --id [--comment]
  replyall  Reply-all to --id [--comment]
  forward   Forward --id --to a,b [--comment]
  move      Move --id --to <folder-id-or-name>
  flag      Flag --id [--status flagged|complete|notFlagged]
  delete    Delete --id

Common flags accepted by every shortcut:
  --pretty   Human-readable output (table for known shapes, indented JSON otherwise)
  --ndjson   Stream collection items one JSON object per line
  --retry    Honor Retry-After once on 429/503
